notes: Nova now detects whether Ollama is installed before importing a GGUF model
Missing Ollama is explained inside Models settings instead of appearing only as an import error
Windows users can download and install the official signed Ollama runtime without leaving Nova
Download percentage and installation phases are displayed live
Nova verifies the Ollama Authenticode signature before installation
A pending GGUF import resumes automatically after Ollama is ready
Nova also detects Ollama in its standard Windows installation folder when PATH has not refreshed
